reviews.review:
Deffinetly a good game. Very bite sized. Depending on your skills i would say you get 2-6 hours out of it, before you hit endgame+ where things just sescalate. A bit like Jets and guns 2, where the super endgame is not about weapon power or survivability, its about lucking in not to hit insta kill things that yes you can avoid, but after a point it becomes inhumanly impossible to do so, so you just hope for a better luck and thats it. I say the game ends there for me. (level 19)

Depending how you level up and how it maches your skill, you might run face first into a grindwall, but there are plenty of oppurnity to farm. And the game pacing while get big difficulty spikes, once you get the proper upgrades your good.

Game has an alien tech random pick up. If you stuck at a map it will give you some that gives ALL upgrades. Now this is a double edge sword. Cuz while it upgrades all your stuff, it also upgrades your speed. And after a point (about 20+) your ship will move so much off center of the camera due to its speed, that you could easilly lose track of it, at which point its just spray and pray.

Very skillsfull and fun to shot, each upgrade you feel, and each map before the super late game feels new and unique with a puzzle like solving. Very well tought out game from bottom to top.

Music is a banger too!

BEST CAMERA MOVEMENT OF ALL TIME!! Gratz dude! you solved it! excelent job there!

What is ♥♥♥♥: sound effects uses windows GLOBAL sound level, so if you want game sounds then you need to adjust that sadlly.
The weapon upgrade falls of super fast. It should allow faster start and charge of megabeam,
Instead of giving you one from each upgrade it should just reduce cost 100% for the first item you buy, 50% the second or something like that.
I think global speed of all objects including player should be reduced by half of speed upgrades. I had rockets that was on the screen for a single frame.
Drones need a SIGNIFICANT buff, they 100% useless, and you never gonna need a money sink in the current economy of the game lol.
Add xp bonus for getting unobtanioum after max bomb count.
reviews.developer_response:
Thank you so much for the thorough review. Some really good ideas there too. I've implemented most of them in today's 1.3.1 release.

I also added optional 'keyboard only' control (UHJK to aim/fire, SPACE for smart bomb), which for me, makes the chaotic bullet hell of levels 20+ feel a tiny bit easier. Gamepad was a Steam Deck compatibility thing, but I definitely preferred mouse + keys.

Indeed, drones were a deliberate money sync for those accruing lots of XP, but needing all the help they can get - I boosted them a bit. Will play test a little more before deciding whether to boost further. Could be fun having loads of drones, or too chaotic?

Oh and ♥ were remaining hit points ;) I didn't want to clutter UI with too many labels. I redesigned this part of UI to be clearer.
